items.t: The Industrial REITs Paying Reliable Passive Income From Warehouses and Logistics Hubs
items.sum: Four industrial landlords are raising rents on expiring leases by double digits, yet each carries a flaw that could trip up income investors. One pays the fattest yield, and another hides a number you should watch every quarter.

items.t: Meet Wall Street’s Dependable High-Yield Dividend Stocks: 4 Companies Still Raising Their Payouts Year After Year
items.sum: Tax law forces REITs to hand over most of their income, leaving almost no cushion for mistakes. So which landlords keep lifting payouts anyway, and what separates the safe raisers from the ones quietly stretching their cash?

items.t: Buy and Hold Forever: 4 Dividend Stocks That Pay You More Every Year
items.sum: Tax law forces REITs to hand over nearly all their income, so a rising payout needs real cash growth behind it. Four equity REITs pass the test, but one has a thin cushion that could keep its raises small.
